rounds.text: Zodiac Ventures Ltd presents a precarious financial profile characterized by severe cash flow instability and a deteriorating ownership structure. Despite reported profits, the company generated a negative operating cash flow of Rs -18.63 Cr and a free cash flow of Rs -18.69 Cr in March 2026, resulting in a concerning cash conversion ratio of -12.10x [E33, E34, E35]. Furthermore, the company’s operational efficiency is in a clear downward trend, with yearly operating margins decreasing over the last four years and a massive 181 percentage point drop in the TTM margin compared to three years prior [E29, E31]. While the company has managed to reduce its borrowings, the reliance on other income—specifically Rs 2.00 Cr—to bolster earnings raises questions about the quality of its core business performance [E38, E54]. Conceded: [E1, E2, E6, E7, E11, E42, E43] The company trades at a significant discount to book value and sector P/E benchmarks, suggesting that the market has already priced in these fundamental risks.
